leads.arxiv: 2605.12493 (arXiv API: v1 2026-05-12; title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues)

phase1_classification.kind_reason: 451 curated questions over web-agent history trajectories (up to 115M tokens). It covers static state recall, dynamic state tracking, workflow knowledge, environment gotchas and premise awareness, scored as QA over memory-provided context.

phase1_verified_types.procedural_workflow: Sec.3.1: "Workflow Knowledge. An experienced colleague knows the steps needed to perform common tasks in the customized environment." This is one of five scored question abilities.
